messages:
Alex W: FYI preflight-orchestrator flagged our rc8 build — approval pending due to SBOM signing lag (cosign), shows "signature_timestamp older than KMS rotation". Any ideas? :thinking:
DeployBot: Preflight check failed: SBOM_SIGNATURE_STALE (code: PF-4321). Required approver: security-team. Docs: https://internal.redwood/sbom
Maria S: Ugh, that's the one. We rotated KMS yesterday so cosign timestamps look invalid to the policy. This is expected for images signed before rotation.
Sam R: Is there an automatic fallback? We can't stall the change window for all teams.
SecurityBot: Policy "sbom-signature-rotation-check" triggered. Options: (1) manual approve (2) pin base image digest (3) timebox rollback. Please respond within 30m or artifact will be auto-quarantined.
Jen K: We should avoid a full rollback. Can we attach additional evidence to the artifact (sigstore attest) to satisfy orchestrator?
Alex W: I tried re-signing the image but CI doesn't have the old key. Rebuild would push back ~2 hours.
Lia P: Legal/compliance says we need an audit note if we manually approve. Fine with manual if we record rationale and retention.
Maria S: Proposal: manual temporary allow for this changelist, add a release-note entry: "SBOM: signature timestamp mismatch due to KMS rotation; verified by security", and schedule rebuild overnight.
Sam R: +1. Also add a canary carveout in the deploy command. Example:
```
deploy --canary 5% --rollback-window 30m --annotate "sbom-rotation-allow"
```
Alex W: Security — can you give the manual approve? We need deploy by EOD.
SecurityBot: Manual approval requested by Alex W. Security approvers: Jen K, Marco (not in thread).
Jen K: I can approve. Doing it now. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Approval recorded by Jen K at 1751112380. Preflight gate bypassed (temporary exception id: EX-20260321-7). Release stage: canary 5%.
Maria S: Adding release-note draft to PR now.
Lia P: I'll log the audit note and route to compliance.
Alex W: Thanks all. We'll follow up with a rebuild tomorrow and will revoke the exception once rebuilt.
Sam R: Note to release ops: if canary shows >1% errors auto-rollback policy still applies.
DeployBot: Canary rollout started at 1751112440.
Alex W: Closing thread; will post a short postmortem if anything unexpected shows up.
